title: Council of Masters
html:
#InvestorStyleThe one lesson for us
1John BogleIndexing, low costOwn the whole market cheaply, hold forever — the foundation of an SPY plan
2Ray DalioGlobal macro, balanceUnderstand debt cycles; diversify so no single scenario wipes you out
3Stanley DruckenmillerMacro, liquidityWatch the Fed and liquidity; protect capital first, then press when right
4Howard MarksCycles, riskKnow where we are in the cycle; risk is highest when people feel safest
5Peter LynchGrowth stock pickingKnow what you own and why; time in the market beats timing
6Jim SimonsQuant, systemsRemove emotion — rules and data beat gut feel
7Ken GriffinMulti-strategy, risk controlSize positions so no single bet can sink you
8Paul Tudor JonesMacro trading, defensePlay defense; cut losers, respect the trend
9Seth KlarmanDeep valueMargin of safety; patience and cash are weapons
10Jeremy GranthamBubbles, mean reversionValuations matter long-term; spot bubbles before they pop

Bench (worth knowing): Larry Fink (BlackRock), David Tepper (Appaloosa), Bill Ackman (Pershing Square), Michael Burry (contrarian), Cathie Wood (innovation growth).
